title.rendered: Shop For Your School at MudPuddles – 11/13-11/19

content.rendered: Shop for your school at MudPuddles Toys and Books the week of 11/13 – 11/19. Mention Middleton at checkout and MudPuddles will donate 20% of your purchase back to Middleton! MudPuddles is located at 16420 SW Langer Dr. in Sherwood. You can shop Monday – Saturday from 10am – 6pm and Sunday 11am – 5pm. Have fun!
